decision: Evaluate the original balance >= quantity guard without adding quantity > 0. Include zero and negative integer quantities when the stated session and balance preconditions are satisfied.
expected_behavior: A zero quantity leaves the numeric balance unchanged, records zero, sets IsWithdraw to true and returns true.
A negative quantity is subtracted from the entry balance, records that same negative quantity, sets IsWithdraw to true and returns true.
scope: Source-preserving verification of the research benchmark; not a recommendation for banking requirements.
